newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi signs $60 mln local deals to build roads.
newsitem.headline: Saudi signs $60 mln local deals to build roads.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Tuesday signed deals worth 227.6 million riyals ($60.7 million) with local companies to construct three roads in the southwestern Jizan province, the official Saudi Press Agency said.

"The ministry of communications today (Tuesday) concluded three deals to construct roads which will be a total of 318 km (200 miles) in length in the governorate and cities of Jizan," the agency said.
The projects, which would be completed within four years by three Saudi companies, were announced by Communications Minister Nasser bin Mohammad al-Saloum. ($1=3.75 riyals)
